title: Provider-neutral Forge seam with a GitHub adapter
summary: Introduces a provider-neutral `forge` module: a `Forge` trait (branch, pull request, status block, review, check status, head commit, capabilities), a pure `report_change` step that runs those calls in one fixed order, and an in-memory `FakeForge` double. A new `github` module becomes the first adapter, wrapping the existing `GhClient` command runner, and the `osf` CLI's review-post, status-apply and status-refresh paths are rewired to call the trait instead of shelling out directly. A new `osf forge pr open` command and a `develop` skill are added on top.

lanes.label: osf CLI
lanes.subtitle: command entry points
lanes.summary: The clap command surface in main.rs: review post, pr status apply/refresh, and the new forge pr open.

lanes.label: Forge core
lanes.subtitle: provider-neutral seam
lanes.summary: The new `forge` module: the trait, its data types, the ordered Report step, and the in-memory double.

lanes.label: Adapters
lanes.subtitle: code-host implementations
lanes.summary: The `github` module that implements the trait over the installed command-line tool, plus the `GhClient` runner it drives.

lanes.label: Code host
lanes.subtitle: external
lanes.summary: The remote code host the adapter's commands reach.

nodes.label: osf main
nodes.subtitle: clap dispatch
nodes.summary: Adds the `forge pr open` subcommand and rewires review post, status apply and status refresh to build the GitHub adapter once and call the trait.

nodes.label: forge pr open
nodes.subtitle: forge_pr_open_cmd
nodes.summary: Requires a builder token, resolves the repo from the origin remote, reads the body file, prepends the work item line, and calls `Forge::open_pull_request`.

nodes.label: review post
nodes.subtitle: review_post_cmd / post_plan
nodes.summary: Reads the head commit through the forge, builds a `NewReview` from the plan, and reports the `PostedReview` or `ForgeError` as output and exit code.

nodes.label: pr status apply
nodes.subtitle: pr_status_apply_cmd
nodes.summary: Dry run still reads the body through the client; the real path now calls `Forge::write_status_block`.

nodes.label: pr status refresh
nodes.subtitle: pr_status_refresh_run
nodes.summary: Gates now come from `Forge::read_check_status` (or a checks JSON file) and the write goes through `Forge::write_status_block`.

nodes.label: Forge trait
nodes.subtitle: create_branch … capabilities
nodes.summary: Seven operations over provider-neutral types: branch, pull request, status block, review, check status, head commit, capabilities. Object-safe and Send + Sync.

nodes.label: Forge types
nodes.subtitle: PullRequestId, Verdict, ReadOutcome
nodes.summary: The plain data the trait moves: identifiers, verdicts, review comments, check status, and the Found/Empty/Unknown read outcome that separates 'nothing' from 'could not read'.

nodes.label: report_change
nodes.subtitle: ordered Report step
nodes.summary: Runs open pull request, write status block, read capabilities, post review, read check status in one fixed order, stopping at the first failure and naming the step. Skips the post when a known verdict list omits the draft verdict.

nodes.label: FakeForge
nodes.subtitle: in-memory double
nodes.summary: Records every call as plain data, scripts per-operation answers, and can be told to fail an operation. Performs no process, file, network or clock work.

nodes.label: GitHub adapter
nodes.subtitle: impl Forge for GitHub<C>
nodes.summary: Implements the trait over a `GhClient`: API POSTs for branch and pull request, body read/apply/edit for the status block, the review post with self-review fallback, and check-status and capability reads.

nodes.label: RealGh
nodes.subtitle: GhClient over the command line
nodes.summary: Spawns the installed command-line tool, writes stdin, and returns the raw exit status, stdout and stderr. Moved here from pr_status and review.

nodes.label: GhClient trait
nodes.subtitle: run + view/edit
nodes.summary: Gains a `run` method that returns raw `GhOutput`; the concrete implementation moves out to the github module, leaving pr_status pure.

nodes.label: pr_status helpers
nodes.subtitle: parse_checks / gates_from_checks
nodes.summary: The checks parser is split into `parse_checks` returning triples and `gates_from_checks` building the gate spec, so the adapter can reuse the parse without the gate mapping.

nodes.label: review helpers
nodes.subtitle: payload / classify / fallback
nodes.summary: Keeps the pure payload building, result classification and fallback decision; `fetch_head_sha` and `post_via_gh` are removed and `parse_head_sha_json` is made public for the adapter.

nodes.label: Code host
nodes.subtitle: remote API
nodes.summary: The remote service the adapter's commands reach: pull requests, reviews, checks and refs.

views.title: Forge seam and its callers
views.summary: The CLI commands now depend on the `Forge` trait rather than the command line directly; the GitHub adapter is the only implementation that reaches the host.

views.title: Report step internals
views.summary: Inside the forge core: `report_change` drives the trait in one fixed order, and the fake double implements the same trait for tests.
